per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 50 free-model requests a day with no fee; monthly plans raise the allowance to 2,000 (Lite), 10,000 (Plus) or 100,000 (Pro) free-model requests a day.

chaining: the 50-per-day free-model cap binds immediately on the standing free plan

limits.value: 50 free-model requests per day on the Free plan

identity_cost.detail: an account is required; a card is only used for a monthly plan or funding

reliability_note: free-model offers are buyer-paid at the exchange fee floor of at most 1 cent per million tokens, so a 'free' model is not zero cost

evidence.proved: the Free plan allows 50 free-model requests a day at no fee
evidence.quote: 50 free-model requests a day. No fee.

notes: Free offers still carry an exchange fee; see /docs/fees.md.
